headline: The 0Ch to 0Dh transition is made one frame after 004dfb70 returns. 004db920 is the state 0Ch frame handler and picks one of two arms on game+1FE4h and session+29Ch: an input-device 'press any button' edge, or a local-player slot-binding wait in view mode 1. Both arms fall into 004da6c0, which zeroes the scaled frame delta, releases the game+30h dynamics list, rearms the five one-shot bytes game+1EE1h..+1EE5h, applies the in-game interface, writes game+5D4h = 0Dh, and clears both cinematic flags plus game+608h so the simulation gate opens. In a networked session it first runs 004d87b0, which can abort the entry.

corrections_offered: The packet brief names 004dc6a0 BSP_Game_ConstructWorld and 004de610 BSP_Game_LoadSceneContents. The ledger has the opposite pairing: 004dc6a0 is BSP_Game_ConstructGlobalSubsystems and 004de610 is BSP_Game_ConstructWorld, and the bodies agree with the ledger.

docs/MISSION_SCENE_LOAD.md and the earlier 004db920 evidence describe the player-count arm as firing 'when fewer than two are active'. The listing counts slots that are NOT bound (+9h and +0Eh both zero) and waits while that count is at least one, so the condition is 'every slot bound', not a threshold of two.

The earlier 004db920 evidence reads game+1FE4h zero OR session+29Ch clear as the device arm. That is correct, but it also says the device arm dispatches into 'the scene at game+1EF0h'; game+1EF0h is the embedded network session, which is what 0076a9f0 and 004b6260 both take (docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md already records the latter).
